quickstart.why_answer: Because deciding what kind of book it is, how long it should be and who it is for are easier once some of it exists. None of those choices are lost by starting here — they are waiting in the studio whenever you want them.

guided.have_outline_detail: Paste a list of chapter titles and it becomes the binder. Indented lines become chapters under a part.
guided.paste_outline_detail: One title per line. Numbering is stripped — the binder keeps the order. Indent a line to put it under the one above. Chapters you have already written words into are left alone.

booktype.nonfiction_blurb: Practical or informational writing with an argument to make.
booktype.memoir_blurb: Your own life, told as a story rather than a record.
booktype.business_blurb: A professional book built around a method or an argument.
booktype.technical_blurb: Documentation, a manual, or a book that teaches a skill.
booktype.academic_blurb: A thesis, monograph or scholarly work.
booktype.masters_thesis_blurb: A master's thesis or dissertation, in any field.
booktype.phd_dissertation_blurb: A doctoral dissertation or thesis, in any field.
booktype.phd_publication_blurb: A doctoral thesis built around three or more papers, with framing and linking chapters.
booktype.masters_project_blurb: A design, build or practice-based project with its written thesis: requirements, design, evaluation.
booktype.childrens_blurb: A picture book or early reader.
booktype.cookbook_blurb: Recipes, usually grouped by course or season.
booktype.poetry_blurb: A collection, usually arranged in sections.
booktype.biography_blurb: Somebody else’s life, researched and sourced.
booktype.educational_blurb: A textbook or course book, written to be taught from.
booktype.devotional_blurb: Short daily readings, usually dated or numbered.
booktype.self_help_blurb: A book that asks the reader to change something and shows them how.
booktype.graphic_novel_blurb: A script for an illustrated book, written page by page.
booktype.anthology_blurb: A collection of pieces, often by more than one author.
agent.developmental_description: Structure, pacing and argument at chapter level.
agent.fact_checker_description: Claims that need a source before publication.
agent.consistency_description: Terminology, names and facts that disagree across the book.
agent.masters_examiner_description: Reads a thesis chapter as a master's examiner would: aim, literature, method, evidence, citations. Coaches; never writes.
agent.doctoral_examiner_description: Reads a dissertation chapter as a doctoral examiner would: original contribution, rigour, defensibility at the viva. Coaches; never writes.
